description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeDirectoryAPI class within the OrangeHRM Corporate Directory plugin. It tests API methods such as 'getOne', 'getAll', 'create', 'update', and 'delete', focusing on their expected behavior and exception handling.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeDirectoryAPI, testing retrieval and CRUD operation methods, as well as handling unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of the EmployeeDirectoryAPI with various test cases loaded from a data provider.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the EmployeeDirectoryAPI with different test scenarios.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the 'create' method throws a NotImplementedException indicating it is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForCreate' is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Checks that the 'update' method throws NotImplementedException, indicating unimplemented functionality.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that 'delete' method throws NotImplementedException, confirming unimplemented status.
